metadata.description: Non-production Tc-99m broad-beam practical shielding transmission model using Archer equation fits reported by Oumano et al. (2025).

provenance.source_title: Shielding resources for four common radiopharmaceuticals utilized for imaging and therapy: Tc-99m, F-18, I-131, and Lu-177
provenance.source_organisation: Journal of Applied Clinical Medical Physics / AAPM
provenance.reference_id: J Appl Clin Med Phys. 2025;26(5):e70084; DOI 10.1002/acm2.70084
provenance.table_or_section: Table 1 material densities; Table 2 Tc-99m Archer parameters; Table 3 fractional value layers; Equations 3-4
provenance.model_notes: GATE broad-beam Monte Carlo model with independent MCNP6 comparison. The paper reports increasing geometry/scatter sensitivity below about 0.01 transmission; room scatter is not represented by the infinite-extent barrier Archer fit.
